text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 responses. A deployment removed the cache warmup step. As a result, some API servers received requests before the cache contained required data. The affected requests returned HTTP 502 errors. The team identified the deployment as the cause and reverted it at 14:27 UTC. Request success rates recovered after the revert. Service operation returned to normal by 14:31 UTC. We are reviewing the deployment process and will add a check for the cache warmup step before future releases. No further impact occurred after service recovery.
